notes.raw:
\*Data extrapolated 300 to 1300 K. 
Phase changes: 1068 K, $\alpha - \beta$ transition point of Pr; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.757$ kcal/mol. 
1204 K, melting point of Pr; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.646$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2500 K: $Cp^{0} = 12.780 + 1.002 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.906 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=12.780\times10^{-3}T+0.501\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.906\times10^{2}T^{-1}-4.159$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-1068 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -123.900 + 4.438 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 2.322 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 127.750 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -123.900 - 4.438 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 2.322 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 63.875 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 53.574 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1068-1204 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -122.267 - 0.582 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} + 0.341 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 56.450 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -122.267 + 0.582 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.341 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 28.225 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 19.913 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1204-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -122.612 - 1.662 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.341 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 56.450 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -122.612 + 1.662 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.341 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 28.225 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 12.539 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K based on Cater (14). Low-temperature heat capacities and entropy at 298 K from Vasilev (123). High-temperature data based on Fesenko (38). Data extrapolated from 300 to 1300 K.
